name: Oberndorf (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided green over black, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Oberndorf (a white wavy bar on green above red and white).
history: Municipal flag of Oberndorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Oberndorf arms — wavy bar over red and white
